713:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Negotiation? Talk in your sleep!」

713:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Why should we gods have to talk on equal footing with the likes of humans?」

713:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You...! Do you still not understand the truth of living in the universe!?」

713:t_003:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We understand the principle of coexistence! That is precisely why we gained power and obtained eternity like this!」

713:t_003:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we joined hands with $$皇帝ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, who became gods just as we did! We stand with the truth!」

713:t_003:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You have no right to speak, when all you've done is barely reach the entrance to $$シンカ$$!」

713:t_003:10.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「In truth, your hearts have already been eaten away by this universe and infected with a sickness called despair!」

713:t_004:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「No matter how tough you talk, it's useless! The despair that has crept into your hearts will devour your very souls!」

713:t_004:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「In the end, humans cannot defeat gods! Admit it!」

713:t_004:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up! I won't lose to words like that!」

713:t_005:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's a shame, $n. You couldn't trust your comrades, and despair took control of your heart.」

713:t_005:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even if it lasted only a moment, it holds enough power to stop you from attaining $$シンカ$$.」

713:t_005:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I've got no strength left... in my body or my heart...」

713:t_005:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「This is bad... This is bad! Hold your souls strong! At this rate...!」

713:t_006:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can't... hear $$バルゴラ$$'s voice...」

713:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's wrong, $$リ・ブラスタ$$...!? Answer me!」

713:t_006:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's useless. You closed off the path to $$シンカ$$ with your own hands.」

713:t_006:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no more interest in you. Rot here.」

713:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He's different from the Advent we knew... He has completely... abandoned us...」

713:t_007:2.en:
$n
「Pull yourself together, Miss $$スズネ$$! Abandoned or not, he's our... the enemy of all humanity!」

713:t_007:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You've done it now, $$御使い$$...! You slipped your own existence into the gaps in their hearts!」

713:t_007:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「If we leave them like this, these fools may turn into $$真徒$$s too!」

713:t_007:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We bury them here! And then, the $$御使い$$s are next!」

713:t_007:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「We have to meet $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness in this state...!」

713:t_008:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Destruction of $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness confirmed.」

713:t_008:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「At this rate, we will be defeated before long...」

713:t_009:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$!」

713:t_009:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What do we do!? If we have to fight him in this state...!」

713:t_009:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn! We came all the way to the universe where they live, and...!」

713:t_009:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I'm disappointed in you, Earthlings.」

713:t_009:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The power you once held... $$真化融合$$...」

713:t_009:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That was a dream to us.」

713:t_009:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is the answer.」

713:t_010:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you mean, this is the answer!?」

713:t_010:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$真化融合$$... That theory was being proposed in the world we came from, too.」

713:t_010:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But a theory is only a theory... We were unable to reach that state.」

713:t_010:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「What was developed as a substitute for it is the $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$.」

713:t_010:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「The substance that creates $$次元獣$$s...!」

713:t_010:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「A $$次元獣$$ forcibly fuses man and machine, and draws out an even greater power through $$次元力$$...」

713:t_010:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So that, too, is a sort of pseudo-$$真化融合$$.」

713:t_010:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your existence was the fruition of the unattainable dream of our world.」

713:t_010:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「At the same time, it meant denying everything we had done... the entire army of $$次元獣$$s.」

713:t_010:11.en:
$$桂$$
「So that's why you can't accept that we exist.」

713:t_010:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「'Irreconcilable' would be the better word.」

713:t_010:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But a dream was only a dream. In the end, you threw that power away yourselves.」

713:t_010:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am not one to lose to such people!」

713:t_011:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「This power...! It's far greater than when we fought at $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

713:t_011:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...Come to think of it, I have fought up to this day by forcing others to sacrifice...」

713:t_011:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers who were made to fight on orders, without even being told the circumstances...」

713:t_011:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, who wished for revenge for her father's life and the freedom of the $$ハイアデス$$ taken from her...」

713:t_011:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$, who sought to strike down anyone who perverted his clan's mission...」

713:t_011:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$, who swore obedience to them and warped his hatred, though all his kin had been destroyed...」

713:t_011:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, who was ashamed of drifting between anger and resignation, and regained the will and pride to live again...」

713:t_011:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And the Reactor of the $$立ち上がる射手$$ who came before me, who challenged the $$御使い$$s with indomitable fighting spirit...」

713:t_011:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「By taking their lives, I gained the power of four $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_011:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I must fight...! And I must win!」

713:t_011:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Earthlings... and Reactors! Offer me all the power you have left!」

713:t_011:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will surpass you and challenge God! To repay the lives I have taken, too!!」

713:t_012:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With our strength as it is now...」
